decisions: Reachability: strict 100 % of ArenaCellCount is NOT reachable. A head center never leaves {SignedDistance <= -ArenaMargin} and CaptureSolver seeds every Void cell and the box border, so the cells between the inset line and the rim are outside for every capture: 7 412 of 256 652 cells (2.89 %) on the square arena. Pieces of a country beyond a neck narrower than 2 x ArenaMargin are unreachable too.

Goal definition: denominator = conquerable cells (Conquest.ConquerableMask: head cells = arena cells whose center is in the inset shape and in a 4-connected piece holding a player position; non-head cells joined to the Void / grid border through non-head cells are out). Threshold = ceil(C x (min(ConquestShare,1) - 0.005)): met exactly when the HUD (whole percents from 10 %) reads the goal, i.e. '100 %' from 99.5 %. The slack absorbs cut corners, stair notches and v1.5/v1.6 specks, and lets a rival alive on a speck under 0.5 % not block the win.

Percentage shown everywhere = Simulation.ConquestPercent = 100 x min(owned, C) / C (HUD labels, leaderboard, '+x %' gains, results, best score, Europe-independent). The numerator counts every owned cell, including rim cells a trail crossed just outside the mask (about 0.6 % of C after a full rim tour), clamped at 100 %: a per-player masked count would need a full grid scan per frame. AreaPercent (R20, over ArenaCellCount) is unchanged for the Core and the bots.

Proof: ConquestTests ends rounds by Conquest with scripted rim tours on the square arena (t = 49.6 s, 99.60 %), with a rival alive on a 0.23 % speck (ends by Conquest, rival rank 2), and on a non-convex polygon with a 0.6 u neck (t = 42.3 s, 99.91 %; the 4 320-cell piece beyond the neck is excluded). With the goal off, a full tour leaves 72 of 249 240 (square) and 132 of 108 237 (polygon) conquerable cells unowned. All 46 Europe levels keep at least 70.8 % of their arena cells conquerable (smallest: NO).

ArenaPolygon fix found by the proof: a head sliding along a country border advanced 48 x 1e-4 u per tick (about 0.3 u/s instead of 6 u/s), so the rim of a country could hardly be painted by a human pushing on it. MinBorderStep = 0.01 u (still far below the 0.9 u a step would need to skip an inlet; a step leaving the inset shape is still refused). Not touched: the square arena (classic and probe hashes unchanged). This changes country-round motion for humans and bots (better).

Mask cost: built lazily and cached; the round end check builds it only once a living player owns 0.5 x 0.995 of the arena cells (sound because every level keeps > 0.5 conquerable, tested); the HUD reads a percentage at round start, so country rounds build it during the ready gate: up to 110 ms (IE) in the editor.

Round end order kept: last survivor (n >= 2) wins at once, then all eliminated, then Conquest, then TimeUp (largest land, ties shared). In 4-player rounds a full conquest usually eliminates everyone first, so most conquest wins still read 'Dernier survivant !'; Conquest fires when rivals survive on specks, in single-player rounds, or with a lower ConquestShare.

Round time: Tuning.RoundDuration stays 90 (Core tests and bot rounds); the runtime sets 900 through SaveData (choices 5/10/15 min, default 15). The round time is still a hidden test setting: 5 or 10 min marks the round as 'réglages modifiés' (no stats, no Europe win), 15 min does not. A saved value below 300 s (60/90/120) reads as 900. -roundDuration now clamps to [5, 900].

Results: main button 'PAYS SUIVANT' always goes to the country screen (also for a loss, per 'dans tous les cas'); 'REJOUER' replays the same country; Escape on the results does the same as PAYS SUIVANT. The pause panel MENU button still goes to the main menu (abandon).

First launch: the current flow never starts a tutorial round by itself (boot -> menu over the attract match), so nothing changed: JOUER opens the country screen with France (the only playable country) selected, and the tutorial bubbles run in that first France round.

Square arena: still reachable through GameDirector.StartRound() with no country, StartCountry(null), the probe, DevShot, TraitFxLab / RenderLab and tests. The attract match is unchanged (square, 90 s).
Europe win counting: unchanged rule (rank 1, shared included), which covers Conquest, LastSurvivor and first at TimeUp; now asserted per reason (FlowV17Tests).
The HUD timer reads m:ss ('15:00', '9:59', '0:07') instead of mm:ss.
